name: Notice dispute where emails prove earlier notice
description: A notice argument is weakened by emails showing earlier notice and reservation of rights.

documents.text: The opposition argues no notice occurred before suit and therefore the claim is premature. The argument says there was never written notice.

emails.subject: Formal notice
emails.text:
From: buyer@example.com
To: seller@example.com
Date: January 14, 2025 8:15 AM EST
Subject: Formal notice

This is written notice of breach. We reserve all rights and request cure by January 24.
